description_ru: Современное звено. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас р. Оми и ее притоков. Суглинки, пески, реже глины
note: GGK-200 N-43-IV (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, 1st edition, approved 1985, printed 1990; Om valley / Baraba, 75-76E 55d20m-56dN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2388 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); legend with a/b variants: a = cover unit on pre-Quaternary rocks (colour fill), b = the same cover over Quaternary units, printed as SYMBOLS over the base colour (fraction labels cover/base): peat bIV = green inverted-T marks, lake-bog lbIV = blue dashes, subaerial saIII (and eolian vIII) = red dashes; the symbol regions are detected (work/r200d/prep_overprint.py: tee-mode green, blue, sa-mode red; glyph buffer ~0.8 x symbol spacing ~1 km) and carried as composites <cover>/<base> (hclass of the cover: O, L, E (PI decision 2026-10-04); hclass2 = base); tints calibrated on the map, aIV/vIII/bIV pinned (map / legend tints); LI-IIfd (Fedosovo suite) coded lacustrine as printed (the 1:1M N-43_pq codes it loessoid + lake-alluvium); frame = 4 corners (paper edge and ridge filter agree) + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties ; map tint of the floodplain strips (calibration drifted onto saIII)
